title: Winter Event Clothing Case Study: 2,000 Sets | LF Clothing
description: How LF coordinated 2,000 winter event outfits for a 2019 Mercedes-Benz program: jackets, trousers, matching gloves and branded knitted hats, delivered in 30 days.
heading: 2,000 winter event outfits, coordinated as one.
intro: LF brought jackets, cold-weather trousers, gloves and knitted hats into one winter clothing program, with matched materials, coordinated branding and a shared black colour direction.
summary: In 2019, LF supplied 2,000 winter event clothing sets for a Mercedes-Benz program: jackets, cold-weather trousers, gloves and knitted hats, delivered in 30 days.
outfit: Black hooded outerwear with red trim, providing the shell fabric reference for the gloves.
Trousers completing the black winter outfit.
Outer fabric matched to the jacket for consistent colour and texture.
Black knitwear with custom logo branding.

sections.heading: Matching Colour and Surface Texture
sections.body: LF used the same outer fabric for the jacket and the gloves. Matching the actual fabric kept the shade of black and surface texture consistent across two different products.

sections.heading: A Warmth Solution for Cold Conditions
sections.body: The project used 3M Thinsulate insulation with fleece on the inside. This warmth solution followed the cold-weather brief alongside the appearance of the complete outfit.

sections.heading: What LF Brought Together
sections.body: The order combined clothing and accessories in one event program. LF brought the material choices, shared colour direction, custom branding and delivery requirements together across the range.
items: A jacket, cold-weather trousers, gloves and a knitted hat in each set.

outcome: The 2019 program was completed in 30 days. This is the delivery record for this project; a new schedule is confirmed around the products, materials, quantities, approvals and destination.
